    Column sums #

    The two sums over the choices in a new column, evaluated by induction on the set R of candidate rows (a finite set in a linear order).

    • psi R (Lemma 7.3): the sum over subsets Cont ⊆ R of continued rows and admissible column cutoffs; it equals Δ_q(x^{|R| + 1}).
    • theta R (equation (8.5)): the sum over subsets J ⊆ R of admissible starts, weighted by the number of admissible starts of the extension; it equals x^{|R| + 1} + q x² Δ_q(x^{|R|}).

    The pretorsion column sum #

    noncomputable def PretorsionImageClosed.Statement.psiTerm {ι : Type u_1} [LinearOrder ι] (R Cont : Finset ι) :
    Polynomial Rq

    The weight of the choice of continued rows Cont ⊆ R, summed over the admissible column cutoffs: α = 0, or α = e + 1 for a continued row e all of whose predecessors in R are continued.

        The image-closed column sum #

        source
        def PretorsionImageClosed.Statement.admCount {ι : Type u_1} [LinearOrder ι] (R J : Finset ι) :
        ℕ

        The number of admissible starts after adjoining the intervals [a, d], a ∈ J, to a family with admissible starts R (Lemma 8.4(2)): |R| + 1 if J = ∅, and otherwise the number of starts ≤ min J plus |J|.
